mentions.name: Speak4Me
mentions.description: An augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) iOS app for non-verbal adults that uses LLM-generated phrases to speed up communication.
mentions.problem: Standard grid-based AAC apps require users to build significant motor memory to navigate them quickly, which the author's father (who lost his speech to throat cancer) could not do, making fast communication difficult.
mentions.audience: Non-verbal adults who have lost the ability to speak
mentions.source_excerpt: I am developing an augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) iOS app for non-verbal adults that uses LLM-generated phrases to speed up communication. My father had throat cancer and lost the ability to speak. He was prescribed a standard grid-based AAC app but couldn't build the motor-memory needed to navigate it quickly.
